Name: Sober
Notes: ROUND AN - THE DRUNK METER (Anthony, 8 Oct: in the pub, when a player drinks, their drunk meter reaches certain levels that give them special treatment). FROM is the % on the meter where this level starts; the rows can be in any order and the highest one he has reached is his level. Sober: nothing poured takes hold - no elemental brew, no inspirational brew.

Name: Tipsy
Notes: TURNS (Anthony, 9 Oct): a brew with a Becomes - the Fire Brew - changes his class only if he was already this drunk BEFORE he drank it; too sober and he only gets its element and abilities. Move the word to another level to change where. BREWS: from here the elemental brews (an Element in Brews.csv, the turning beers too) and the inspirational ones (any brew that gives an ability) take hold. Below this they can still be drunk (Anthony, 8 Oct: an elemental brew can always be drunk) and fill the meter, but they do nothing in the match, and a turning beer does not count towards turning him. DRAFT number - yours to change.
